title: Change something already approved
summary: Changes approved scope in the open: a written request, a human decision, the spec edit, then a fresh plan signature.

steps.title: Raise the change request
steps.does: Anyone, Bob included, writes sdd/specs/change-requests/CR-###-<slug>.md: why, options, impact, and which files it affects. A GitHub issue from the change-request form is a good starting point.

steps.title: Owner decides
steps.terminal: node sdd/scripts/approve.mjs cr CR-### --decision approved|rejected --option A
steps.does: The decision is bound to the hash of the change-request file.

steps.title: Apply it to the specs
steps.does: Bob edits only the files the request lists under "affects"; commits are spec(CR-###): …

steps.title: Owner re-signs the plan
steps.when: the request changed an approved feature's spec or plan
steps.does: The new signature cites the approved change request; code follows only after it.
